I implemented `parse`, `parse_script` and `parse_expression` in `minidb/parser.py`. All 33 tests in `tests/test_parser.py` pass. I didn't run the integration tests or the rest of the suite. I also didn't change `tests/test_parser.py`.

The parser follows the grammar in `minidb.types`. If a token list doesn't end with an EOF token, the parser appends one rather than failing.
